## Bug fixes

- Native Git hooks keep observing their original check when acknowledgment or completion crosses a status read. An incomplete observation no longer aborts a still-running check; the original deadline and failure rules remain in force.
- Exhaustive secret checks stream Git blobs in one batch instead of starting a process for every tracked file. Publishable worktree and index coverage remains complete, including staged-only secrets.
- Native pre-push forwards an explicitly selected `GOVERNANCE_PRE_PUSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` deadline. The default remains 300 seconds, invalid values refuse, and required checks and cleanup remain blocking.

This is a maintenance update for installations on the 4.2 line. It includes the 4.2.2 documentation/startup corrections, preserves dependencies, configuration schema and runtime stores, and does not adopt the later 4.5 features. Version 4.5.18 remains the latest stable release. Upgrades are deliberate; publication does not change installed pins, resume aborted Git operations, move conversations or rebind tasks.

Qualification used the normal local compiled-package process: 23 focused cases, typecheck/build, the full suite (1,349 passed, 17 skipped), installed greenfield and staged-secret checks, and dedicated coding-agent self-review. Normal source hooks passed. The same frozen archive also passed a normal adopter pre-push check. No separate-model review, live provider/device qualification or performance improvement beyond the measured checks is claimed. Hosted CI was not used for this 4.x manual publication.
